description: Header file defining the ExtendedResourcesManager class for managing D3D12 extended resources in UWP environment, including methods for acquiring, releasing, and querying GPU resources, as well as handling shader compilation status and failure states.

classes.name: ExtendedResourcesManager
classes.description: Manages acquiring and releasing of extended GPU resources, shader compilation status, and error handling in a UWP environment.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of the manager.

methods.name: GetD3D12Objects
methods.description: Retrieves D3D12 device, heap, and command queue objects.

methods.name: IsGpuDecoderReady
methods.description: Checks if shaders for AV1 and VP9 are compiled and ready.

methods.name: OnNonrecoverableFailure
methods.description: Marks the driver as in a non-recoverable error state.

methods.name: HasNonrecoverableFailure
methods.description: Checks if a non-recoverable failure has occurred.

methods.name: IsSafeToSuspend
methods.description: Indicates if it's safe to suspend based on failure state.
